## Security checklist

- [ ] No credentials or private data are committed.
- [ ] Tokens are not written to logs or Git remotes.
- [ ] Destructive operations require explicit intent.
- [ ] Authentication changes preserve GitHub App + OAuth + PKCE.
- [ ] Native/JNI changes handle ownership and errors safely.
